passages.text:
Thanks Blair - moving speakers to BCC to save their inboxes. :)
Below is theinfo theysent about notes including a template and where we should save summary highlights by COB.
Can you create one document and share with the other note takers and we just fill it out and I can save it in the highlights
folder today?
Thanks
Meral
1. Notetaking. Session owners are responsible for identifying notetakers for their sessions. These notes
will play a critical role in recording key points and creating the final report. We have created a
Notetaking Template that should be used for all notes. This template includes:
a. Summary Highlights. The template includes a space at the top to include a very brief summary
(bullet points) of main take-away points that should be made available that same day. This
information will be used to inform openings and closings. The draft notes can be saved in the file
DRAFT Session Notes During Conference.
a. The Full Set of Notes. The final, completed set of notes is due within 5 working days of the
conference. Session owners are responsible for coordinating with their notetakers andfor
consolidating notes. Please note that we are not seeking a transcript, but rather a summary of key
issues and main points.
The same location includes a file where you can upload completed notes.
Meral Karan
Team Lead, Democratic Resilience and Innovation Team
Center for Democracy, Human Rights, and Governance
US Agency for International Development
